text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "Zenno Rob Roy has conquered the Kikuka-sho! It's Zenno Rob Roy!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A late-blooming champion who couldn't make it
in time for the start of the Classic Triple Crown,
now claiming the magnificent chrysanthemum!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"It might not be worthy of being called a heroic saga just yet.
Even so...!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Thank you so very much!
(Waaaaaaaaaaah)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy, Neo Universe
says "congratulations."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Uni-san!
This is all thanks to you...!

The winner was Zenno Rob Roy.
Yet Neo Universe, too,
seemed to have poured out every ounce of her heart.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Trainer, Neo Universe was unable to... 'respond'......"

I answer with a smile. At the very least,
there are no regrets since we were able to take on the challenge together like this.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: A ripple... of phenomena.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the one Neo Universe couldn't beat was
"NUUK." But...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy winning
is slightly "different."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: If there was a catalyst for the ripples, it was—
With that said, Neo Universe... seemed to soften the corners of her mouth just a little.
And that night—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, Neo Universe is 'concerned'.
About the Trainer's qualifications......"

I reported that "it was somehow resolved."
Emphasizing that there was no ill intent involved...

Following the correction, no further action was taken.
It seems the URA showed a bit of leniency as well.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
Then the "interstellar space" is—cleared.

Having overcome major trouble together,
I feel our bond has grown even stronger. At this rate—

It seems she'll be able to challenge her "GATE," the Tenno Sho (Spring),
without hesitation.
However, there is still quite a long time before the race.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Neo Universe is......

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
――?
Prior to acoustic wave generation... "Connect"...

Telepathy. I felt Neo Universe's desire
to run somewhere before the Tenno Sho (Spring).
And as for candidate races for the next run...

From what I saw in today's run,
Long distances seem to put quite a heavy toll on her.
In that case...
It would be best to have her gain experience against Senior Class Umamusume in the 'Japan Cup', which is right on the edge of medium distance.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—Affirmative. Neo Universe concurs.
On the "Japan Cup".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"And once we 'observe'
the end of that race—"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Neo Universe――wants to share next year's forecast.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Yes, about "GATE"—and what lies beyond it.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"I want to talk about
Neo Universe after the "GATE"."

...It seemed a momentous "future prediction"
was about to be revealed after the Japan Cup.
